notable_absence.finding: The Query Workbench's own 'Import Data'/'Export Data' buttons (Import Query/History window, Export Query/Data/History window) import and export QUERIES, QUERY HISTORY, and QUERY RESULTS as JSON/text files - a completely different operation from tool:cbimport/tool:cbexport (elsewhere in this same batch), which import and export DOCUMENT DATA to/from buckets. The page never mentions cbimport/cbexport and draws no connection, correctly, but the shared 'Import'/'Export' button names sitting in the same product surface as two unrelated CLI tools of nearly the same name is a real naming collision worth recording explicitly so reconciliation does not accidentally merge them.

cross_component_finding: tool:query-workbench was promoted at recurrence 8 with its defining fact ('supplies txid and tximplicit implicitly') carried only in the promoted registry's own type string, with no extraction-record citation behind it - every prior attestation came from Capella pages per this round's context file. This page is the first Server-side, same-page, directly-quotable source for exactly that fact (the implicitlySetsParameter relations above), and is otherwise the fullest single description of the tool in the corpus (Query Editor, Results, Explore Your Data/bucket analyzer, Index Advisor, Query Preferences) - the eight prior Capella-side attestations were necessarily partial views of one Server-implemented feature reused unchanged on Capella.
cross_product_finding: No Capella page states a divergence from this page's behavior; the prior 8 attestations of tool:query-workbench (all Capella-side, per the batch context) describe the identical tool. This page adds detail no Capella page had already stated (e.g. the Community Edition External Query Advisor fallback, which is Server-edition-specific and has no Capella analogue since Capella has no Community Edition).
